questionText: Find the value of cot1°.cot2°.cot3° _______ cot89°.
questionTextHi: cot1°.cot2°.cot3° _______ cot89° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
Key fact: cot θ × cot(90° − θ) = cot θ × tan θ = 1.
Pair the terms: (cot1° × cot89°), (cot2° × cot88°), … up to (cot44° × cot46°) = 44 pairs, each equal to 1.
Middle term cot45° = 1.
So total value = 1 × 1 = 1.
explanationHi:
मुख्य नियम: cot θ × cot(90° − θ) = cot θ × tan θ = 1
जोड़े बनाइए: (cot1° × cot89°), (cot2° × cot88°), … (cot44° × cot46°) = 44 जोड़े, हर जोड़ा 1 के बराबर।
बीच वाला पद cot45° = 1
अतः कुल मान = 1 × 1 = 1

questionText: The average marks scored by boys in a class is 72. The average marks of class is 77 and there are total 40 students in the class. If number of girls in class is 25 then find the average marks of girls in class.
questionTextHi: एक कक्षा में लड़कों के औसत अंक 72 हैं। कक्षा के औसत अंक 77 हैं और कक्षा में कुल 40 विद्यार्थी हैं। यदि कक्षा में लड़कियों की संख्या 25 है, तो लड़कियों के औसत अंक ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
Girls = 25, so Boys = 40 − 25 = 15.
Total marks of class = 77 × 40 = 3080.
Total marks of boys = 72 × 15 = 1080.
Total marks of girls = 3080 − 1080 = 2000.
Average of girls = 2000 / 25 = 80.

questionText: Area of square is 3/5th of area of rectangle. If sides of rectangle are 9 cm and 15 cm, then find the perimeter of the square.

explanation:
Area of rectangle = 9 × 15 = 135 cm².
Area of square = (3/5) × 135 = 81 cm².
Side of square = √81 = 9 cm.
Perimeter of square = 4 × 9 = 36 cm.
explanationHi:
आयत का क्षेत्रफल = 9 × 15 = 135 सेमी²
वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = (3/5) × 135 = 81 सेमी²
वर्ग की भुजा = √81 = 9 सेमी
वर्ग का परिमाप = 4 × 9 = 36 सेमी

questionText: 5 kg honey contains 60% sugar. If 3 kg more sugar is added to it then find new sugar percentage.
questionTextHi: 5 किग्रा शहद में 60% चीनी है। यदि इसमें 3 किग्रा और चीनी मिला दी जाए, तो नया चीनी प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
Sugar in 5 kg honey = 60% of 5 = 3 kg.
Other matter = 5 − 3 = 2 kg (this stays the same).
After adding 3 kg sugar: sugar = 3 + 3 = 6 kg, total mixture = 5 + 3 = 8 kg.
New sugar % = (6/8) × 100 = 75%.
explanationHi:
5 किग्रा शहद में चीनी = 5 का 60% = 3 किग्रा
अन्य पदार्थ = 5 − 3 = 2 किग्रा (यह अपरिवर्तित रहता है)
3 किग्रा चीनी मिलाने पर: चीनी = 3 + 3 = 6 किग्रा, कुल मिश्रण = 5 + 3 = 8 किग्रा
नया चीनी प्रतिशत = (6/8) × 100 = 75%

explanation:

questionText: Two numbers are in ratio 14 : 9, if HCF and LCM of both numbers are 3 and 378, then find the greater number.
questionTextHi: दो संख्याएँ 14 : 9 के अनुपात में हैं। यदि उनका HCF 3 और LCM 378 है, तो बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
For numbers in ratio a : b (coprime), HCF = k and numbers = k·a, k·b.
HCF = 3 → numbers = 3 × 14 = 42 and 3 × 9 = 27.
Check LCM: 42 = 2×3×7, 27 = 3³ → LCM = 2×3³×7 = 378 ✔
Greater number = 42.
explanationHi:
a : b अनुपात (सह-अभाज्य) वाली संख्याओं के लिए HCF = k और संख्याएँ = k·a, k·b
HCF = 3 → संख्याएँ = 3 × 14 = 42 तथा 3 × 9 = 27
जाँच LCM: 42 = 2×3×7, 27 = 3³ → LCM = 2×3³×7 = 378 ✔
बड़ी संख्या = 42

questionText: Diagonals of the square ABCD are meeting at O. If side of square is a, then find the area of triangle AOB.
questionTextHi: वर्ग ABCD के विकर्ण O पर मिलते हैं। यदि वर्ग की भुजा a है, तो त्रिभुज AOB का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
Diagonals of a square divide it into 4 equal triangles → area of each triangle = (1/4) × area of square.
Area of square = a², so area of triangle AOB = a²/4.
(Details: OB = a/√2, height from A to OB along the other diagonal = a/√2 → area = ½ × a/√2 × a/√2 = a²/4 ✔)
explanationHi:
वर्ग के विकर्ण उसे 4 समान त्रिभुजों में बाँटते हैं → प्रत्येक त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल = (1/4) × वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल
वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल = a², अतः त्रिभुज AOB का क्षेत्रफल = a²/4
(विस्तार: OB = a/√2, A से OB पर लंब = a/√2 → क्षेत्रफल = ½ × a/√2 × a/√2 = a²/4 ✔)

questionText: In a town there are two schools A and B. In school A there are 75% of total students out of which 20% students are failed in exam. If 10% students of school B are failed in exam then find the overall passing percentage of the town.
questionTextHi: एक कस्बे में दो विद्यालय A और B हैं। विद्यालय A में कुल विद्यार्थियों का 75% है, जिनमें 20% परीक्षा में अनुत्तीर्ण हुए। यदि विद्यालय B के 10% विद्यार्थी अनुत्तीर्ण हुए, तो कस्बे का कुल उत्तीर्ण प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
Let total students = 100.
School A = 75, fail = 20% of 75 = 15.
School B = 25, fail = 10% of 25 = 2.5.
Total failed = 15 + 2.5 = 17.5.
Overall passing % = 100 − 17.5 = 82.5%.

Diagonal = 12√2 cm. This diagonal becomes the side of the new square.

questionText: Ravi sold two television sets, one at a profit of 10%, and the other at a loss of 10%. Find the overall loss or gain percentage in the overall transaction.
questionTextHi: रवि ने दो टेलीविज़न बेचे — एक 10% लाभ पर और दूसरा 10% हानि पर। पूरे लेन-देन में कुल लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
explanation:
When two articles are sold at the same selling price, one at x% profit and the other at x% loss, there is always a net loss of x²/100 %.
Here x = 10 → loss = 10²/100 = 1%.
So there is an overall loss of 1%.
explanationHi:

यहाँ x = 10 → हानि = 10²/100 = 1%
अतः कुल 1% हानि होगी।

questionText: 6 men and 8 women can complete a piece of work in 10 days while 13 men and 24 women can complete the same piece of work in 4 days. Find the ratio of work efficiency of a man and a woman?

explanation:
Let 1 man's 1-day work = m and 1 woman's 1-day work = w.
Total work: 10(6m + 8w) = 4(13m + 24w)
60m + 80w = 52m + 96w
8m = 16w → m = 2w → m : w = 2 : 1.
explanationHi:
मान लीजिए 1 पुरुष का 1 दिन का कार्य = m और 1 महिला का = w
कुल कार्य: 10(6m + 8w) = 4(13m + 24w)
60m + 80w = 52m + 96w
8m = 16w → m = 2w → m : w = 2 : 1

questionText: HCF and LCM of two numbers are 21 and 252 respectively. If one number is 84, what is the other number?
questionTextHi: दो संख्याओं का HCF 21 और LCM 252 है। यदि एक संख्या 84 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है?
explanation:
Formula: HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers.
21 × 252 = 84 × other → other = (21 × 252)/84 = 5292/84 = 63.
